```{r hyperparameter-tuning}

# Phase 5: Hyperparameter Tuning

# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(yaml)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(class)      
  library(caret)      
  library(reshape2) 
  library(here)
})

#Configuration
cat("Phase 5: Hyperparameter Tuning\n")

# Load config
config_path <- here::here("config", "config.yaml")
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_path)

cat("Configuration loaded\n")

# Load Atlas with Splits
cat("\n[1/6] Loading atlas with splits...\n")

atlas_path <- file.path(config$paths$data_dir, "processed", "atlas_with_splits.rds")
if (!file.exists(atlas_path)) {
  stop("Atlas with splits not found. Run Phase 3 first: ", atlas_path)
}

seurat_atlas <- readRDS(atlas_path)

# Extract test set 
test_cells <- colnames(seurat_atlas)[seurat_atlas$split == "test"]
test_atlas <- seurat_atlas[, test_cells]

cat(sprintf("Test set: %s cells\n", format(ncol(test_atlas), big.mark = ",")))

# Load Balanced Training Datasets 
cat("\n[2/6] Loading SMOTE-balanced training datasets...\n")

smote_dir <- file.path(config$paths$data_dir, "processed", "smote_balanced")
ratios <- config$smote$ratios_to_test
balanced_datasets <- list()

for (ratio in ratios) {
  ratio_clean <- gsub(":", "_", ratio)
  file_path <- file.path(smote_dir, paste0("train_smote_", ratio_clean, ".rds"))
  
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    stop("Balanced dataset not found: ", file_path, "\nRun Phase 4 first.")
  }
  
  balanced_datasets[[ratio]] <- readRDS(file_path)
  
  n_real <- sum(!balanced_datasets[[ratio]]$synthetic)
  n_synthetic <- sum(balanced_datasets[[ratio]]$synthetic)
  
  cat(sprintf("Ratio %s: %d real + %d synthetic = %d total\n",
              ratio, n_real, n_synthetic, n_real + n_synthetic))
}

#k-NN Training & Evaluation Function
cat("\n[3/6] Defining k-NN evaluation function...\n")

evaluate_knn <- function(train_data, test_data, k_value) {
  
  # Extract PCA coordinates for training (first 50 PCs)
  train_pca <- Embeddings(train_data, reduction = "pca")[, 1:50]
  train_labels <- train_data$cell_type
  
  # Extract PCA coordinates for testing
  test_pca <- Embeddings(test_data, reduction = "pca")[, 1:50]
  test_labels <- test_data$cell_type
  
  # Ensure labels are factors with same levels
  all_levels <- sort(unique(c(as.character(train_labels), as.character(test_labels))))
  train_labels <- factor(train_labels, levels = all_levels)
  test_labels <- factor(test_labels, levels = all_levels)
  
  # Predict on test set using Euclidean distance
  predictions <- knn(
    train = train_pca,
    test = test_pca,
    cl = train_labels,
    k = k_value
  )
  
  # Ensure predictions are factor with same levels
  predictions <- factor(predictions, levels = all_levels)
  
  # Calculate confusion matrix
  conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(
    data = predictions,
    reference = test_labels
  )
  
  # Extract metrics
  overall_accuracy <- conf_matrix$overall["Accuracy"]
  
  # Per-class metrics
  per_class <- conf_matrix$byClass
  
  # Handle single class case
  if (is.null(dim(per_class))) {
    per_class <- t(as.matrix(per_class))
    rownames(per_class) <- all_levels[1]
  }
  
  # Calculate weighted F1
  test_class_counts <- table(test_labels)
  test_class_weights <- test_class_counts / sum(test_class_counts)
  
  # Extract F1 scores
  f1_scores <- per_class[, "F1"]
  
  names(f1_scores) <- gsub("Class: ", "", rownames(per_class))
  
  # Replace NAs with 0
  f1_scores[is.na(f1_scores)] <- 0
  
  # Get cell types that appear in test set
  cell_types_in_test <- names(test_class_counts)
  
  # Align F1 scores with test set weights
  f1_aligned <- f1_scores[cell_types_in_test]
  weights_aligned <- as.numeric(test_class_weights[cell_types_in_test])
  
  # Handle any NAs from alignment
  f1_aligned[is.na(f1_aligned)] <- 0
  
  # Calculate weighted F1
  weighted_f1 <- sum(f1_aligned * weights_aligned, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  return(list(
    confusion_matrix = conf_matrix,
    weighted_f1 = weighted_f1,
    overall_accuracy = overall_accuracy,
    per_class_metrics = per_class,
    predictions = predictions
  ))
}

cat("k-NN evaluation function defined\n")

# Hyperparameter Grid Search
cat("\n[4/6] Running hyperparameter grid search...\n")

k_values <- config$knn$k_values_to_test

# Initialize results storage
results_grid <- expand.grid(
  SMOTE_Ratio = ratios,
  k_value = k_values,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
results_grid$weighted_f1 <- NA
results_grid$accuracy <- NA

# Store detailed results
detailed_results <- list()

# Progress counter
total_combinations <- nrow(results_grid)
current_combination <- 0

cat(sprintf("\n  Testing %d combinations (%d SMOTE ratios × %d k values)\n\n",
            total_combinations, length(ratios), length(k_values)))

for (i in 1:nrow(results_grid)) {
  ratio <- results_grid$SMOTE_Ratio[i]
  k <- results_grid$k_value[i]
  
  current_combination <- current_combination + 1
  
  cat(sprintf("  [%d/%d] SMOTE %s, k=%d...",
              current_combination, total_combinations, ratio, k))
  
  # Get training data for this SMOTE ratio
  train_data <- balanced_datasets[[ratio]]
  
  # Evaluate k-NN
  eval_result <- evaluate_knn(train_data, test_atlas, k)
  
  # Store results
  results_grid$weighted_f1[i] <- eval_result$weighted_f1
  results_grid$accuracy[i] <- eval_result$overall_accuracy
  
  # Store detailed results
  combo_name <- paste0("smote_", gsub(":", "_", ratio), "_k", k)
  detailed_results[[combo_name]] <- eval_result
  
  cat(sprintf(" F1=%.4f, Acc=%.4f\n",
              eval_result$weighted_f1,
              eval_result$overall_accuracy))
}

cat("\nGrid search complete\n")

# Select Best Hyperparameters
cat("\n[5/6] Selecting best hyperparameters...\n")

# Find best combination
best_idx <- which.max(results_grid$weighted_f1)
best_ratio <- results_grid$SMOTE_Ratio[best_idx]
best_k <- results_grid$k_value[best_idx]
best_f1 <- results_grid$weighted_f1[best_idx]
best_acc <- results_grid$accuracy[best_idx]


cat("  BEST HYPERPARAMETERS:\n")

cat(sprintf("  • SMOTE Ratio: %s\n", best_ratio))
cat(sprintf("  • k value: %d\n", best_k))
cat(sprintf("  • Weighted F1: %.4f\n", best_f1))
cat(sprintf("  • Accuracy: %.4f\n", best_acc))


# Visualize Results
cat("\n[6/6] Generating visualizations...\n")

results_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "figures", "phase5_tuning")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Heatmap of F1 scores
results_matrix <- results_grid %>%
  select(SMOTE_Ratio, k_value, weighted_f1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = k_value, values_from = weighted_f1) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(results_matrix) <- results_matrix$SMOTE_Ratio
results_matrix$SMOTE_Ratio <- NULL
results_matrix <- as.matrix(results_matrix)

# Melt for ggplot
results_melted <- melt(results_matrix)
colnames(results_melted) <- c("SMOTE_Ratio", "k_value", "F1_Score")

p_heatmap <- ggplot(results_melted, aes(x = factor(k_value), y = SMOTE_Ratio, fill = F1_Score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", F1_Score)), color = "black", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027",
    mid = "#fee08b",
    high = "#1a9850",
    midpoint = median(results_melted$F1_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    name = "Weighted\nF1 Score"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hyperparameter Tuning: Weighted F1 Scores",
    subtitle = sprintf("Best: SMOTE %s, k=%d (F1=%.4f)", best_ratio, best_k, best_f1),
    x = "k value",
    y = "SMOTE Ratio"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "hyperparameter_heatmap.png"),
  plot = p_heatmap,
  width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
)


# Line plot showing trends
p_lines <- ggplot(results_grid, aes(x = k_value, y = weighted_f1, color = SMOTE_Ratio, group = SMOTE_Ratio)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1:3" = "#e41a1c", "1:2" = "#377eb8", "1:1" = "#4daf4a")) +
  labs(
    title = "F1 Score vs k Value by SMOTE Ratio",
    x = "k value",
    y = "Weighted F1 Score",
    color = "SMOTE Ratio"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "f1_by_k_and_smote.png"),
  plot = p_lines,
  width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

cat("Saved line plot\n")

# Confusion matrix for best model
best_combo_name <- paste0("smote_", gsub(":", "_", best_ratio), "_k", best_k)
best_conf_matrix <- detailed_results[[best_combo_name]]$confusion_matrix

# Plot confusion matrix
conf_matrix_df <- as.data.frame(best_conf_matrix$table)

p_conf <- ggplot(conf_matrix_df, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "black", size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2E7D32", name = "Count") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Confusion Matrix: Best Model (SMOTE %s, k=%d)", best_ratio, best_k),
    x = "True Label",
    y = "Predicted Label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "best_model_confusion_matrix.png"),
  plot = p_conf,
  width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300
)

cat("Saved confusion matrix\n")

# Save Results 
cat("\nSaving results...\n")

# Save grid search results
metrics_dir <- file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "metrics")
write.csv(
  results_grid,
  file = file.path(metrics_dir, "phase5_hyperparameter_grid.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save best hyperparameters
best_params <- list(
  best_smote_ratio = best_ratio,
  best_k = best_k,
  best_weighted_f1 = best_f1,
  best_accuracy = best_acc
)

saveRDS(
  best_params,
  file = file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "models", "best_hyperparameters.rds")
)

# Save detailed results
saveRDS(
  detailed_results,
  file = file.path(config$paths$results_dir, "models", "detailed_tuning_results.rds")
)


#Summary

cat("Summary:\n")
cat(sprintf("  • Combinations tested: %d\n", total_combinations))
cat(sprintf("  • Best SMOTE ratio: %s\n", best_ratio))
cat(sprintf("  • Best k value: %d\n", best_k))
cat(sprintf("  • Best weighted F1: %.4f\n", best_f1))
cat(sprintf("  • Best accuracy: %.4f\n", best_acc))
cat(sprintf("  • Results saved to: %s\n", results_dir))

cat("Run Phase 6: Final Validation (src/06_final_validation.R)\n\n")


```

```{r}

# Confusion matrices for the top 5 combinations
library(ggplot2)

# Load detailed results
detailed_results <- readRDS("/projects/b1246/Isaac/immune_classifier/results/models/detailed_tuning_results.rds")
results_grid <- read.csv("/projects/b1246/Isaac/immune_classifier/results/metrics/phase5_hyperparameter_grid.csv")

# Output directory
output_dir <- "/projects/b1246/Isaac/immune_classifier/results/figures/phase5_tuning/top5_confusion_matrices"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Sort by weighted F1 and get top 5
results_grid <- results_grid[order(-results_grid$weighted_f1), ]
top5 <- results_grid[1:5, ]

cat("Top 5 Hyperparameter Combinations:\n")
print(top5[, c("SMOTE_Ratio", "k_value", "weighted_f1", "accuracy")])
cat("\n")

# Define 5 distinct color schemes
color_schemes <- list(
  list(low = "white", high = "#1a9850"),  
  list(low = "white", high = "#2166ac"),  
  list(low = "white", high = "#7570b3"),  
  list(low = "white", high = "#d95f02"),  
  list(low = "white", high = "#e7298a")   
)

# Generate confusion matrices for top 5
for (i in 1:5) {
  ratio <- top5$SMOTE_Ratio[i]
  k <- top5$k_value[i]
  f1 <- top5$weighted_f1[i]
  acc <- top5$accuracy[i]
  
  combo_name <- paste0("smote_", gsub(":", "_", ratio), "_k", k)
  
  # Get confusion matrix
  conf_matrix <- detailed_results[[combo_name]]$confusion_matrix
  conf_matrix_df <- as.data.frame(conf_matrix$table)
  
  # Get color scheme for this rank
  colors <- color_schemes[[i]]
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(conf_matrix_df, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "black", size = 2.5) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = colors$low, high = colors$high, name = "Count") +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Rank #%d: SMOTE %s, k=%d", i, ratio, k),
      subtitle = sprintf("Weighted F1: %.4f | Accuracy: %.4f", f1, acc),
      x = "True Label",
      y = "Predicted Label"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  # Save
  filename <- sprintf("rank%d_confusion_matrix_smote_%s_k%02d.png", 
                     i, gsub(":", "_", ratio), k)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, filename),
    plot = p,
    width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("Saved Rank #%d: SMOTE %s, k=%d (F1=%.4f) - Color: %s\n", 
              i, ratio, k, f1, colors$high))
}
```
